div.head: VIII Atr 5
div.ab: Ne syn ealle cyrcan na gelicre mæðe worldlice wirðe, þeah hi godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
Ne syn ealle cyrican ná gelicre mæðe woroldlice wyrðe, þe hi godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
Ne syn ealle cyrcan na gelicre mæðe worldlice wirðe, þeah hi godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
Ne syn ealle cyrcan na gelicre mæðe worldlice wirðe, þeah hi godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
Keineswegs sind alle Kirchen im bürgerlichen Recht gleichen Ranges theilhaftig, obwohl sie kanonisch die Weihe gleich haben:
By no means are all churches entitled to the same rank in secular law, although they have the same consecration in ecclesiastical terms:
Not all churches are to be regarded as possessing the same status in civil law, though from the side of religion they all possess the same sanctity.
All churches are not entitled to the same status in a temporal sense, although they have the same consecration in regard to religion.
Not all churches are to be considered alike in worldly status, although they all possess the same spiritual sanctity.
